headline: Galaxy S25 and S24 Ultra owners report overheating and battery drain after Samsung's latest update
summary: Users are experiencing significant issues like overheating, excessive battery drain, and slow charging after the recent July software update. Samsung has not yet issued a statement.
details: Owners of Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra and S24 Ultra are reporting severe issues following the recent July software update. These problems include significant overheating, excessive battery drain, and sub-optimal charging speeds.

The July update began rolling out at the start of the month and has since reached more devices. Users who have not yet updated are advised to hold off until Samsung addresses the reported malfunctions.
For those already affected, various theories and temporary solutions are circulating online. One theory suggests an interaction with WhatsApp backups might be causing the phone to heat up.

Some users are attempting workarounds like disabling encrypted backups, though not all are comfortable with this. It is recommended to consult online forums for potential solutions or wait for an official fix from Samsung.
